Nora, adult woman, exact separate identity from the reference: softly angular oval face, warm hazel eyes, short dark brown asymmetrical side-part bob with long sweep on HER RIGHT (viewer left in front view), opposite side tucked behind ear, natural subtle friendly mouth. Extend practical outfit with a knee-length apron with a plain front pocket and waist ties over straight warm beige linen trousers, simple brown leather flat ankle boots. No additional jewelry or props.
Input 1 authoritative FACE identity. Input 2 authoritative FULL OUTFIT, body silhouette and garment construction reference: reproduce it faithfully across views. Generate a full-body turnaround sheet in landscape 3:2, exactly THREE figures side by side on a shared baseline: FRONT, true 90-degree SIDE facing image-left, and BACK facing away. Identical height, same clothing, same neutral relaxed posture with arms resting slightly away from body. Complete crown-to-sole figures with safe white margins, no cropped shoes or hair. Consistent hair length, garment hem, boots, material and colors across all three. No props, no text. Nora's apron bow if present stays on her anatomical left front as in fullbody reference; Maisie's hair reaches past waist consistently.
